description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the PropertyBag class in the org.eclipse.hono.adapter.mqtt package. It verifies the behavior of extracting and handling property bags within MQTT topics, including cases with special characters and absence of property bags.

classes.name: PropertyBagTest
classes.description: JUnit test class that tests the behavior of PropertyBag utility methods related to MQTT topic parsing.

methods.name: verifyPropertiesInPropertyBag
methods.description: Tests extracting property values from a topic that includes a property-bag query string.

methods.name: VerifyWhenNoPropertyBagIsSet
methods.description: Tests that no property-bag is returned when the topic does not contain one.

methods.name: verifyTopicWithSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Tests handling of topics with special characters, ensuring no property-bag is falsely identified.

methods.name: verifyTopicWithoutPropertyBag
methods.description: Verifies that the topic is correctly returned without the property-bag segment.
